meta.name: Generative Edit (MOSS Edit)
meta.licenseNote: MOSS-Image-SFT is Apache-2.0 (OpenMOSS); the MOSS Edit LoRA (chinoll/Moss-Image-Edit, 2026-10) has no licence on its weights, its code (Chenkin-x/Moss-Image-Edit) is GPLv3; bring your own files. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native gn-diffusion moss-image/edit). MOSS Edit (chinoll/Moss-Image-Edit, rank-64 LoRA on MOSS-Image-SFT, models/loras/…/moss-image-edit/adapter_model.safetensors) as its edit contract has it: the picture (long edge 1024, 512 in 12 GB mode) encoded by the FLUX.2 VAE and run once through the DiT as reference tokens at t = 0 (frame 1, attending only to itself), its keys and values cached and attended by the target at every step; the output at the picture's aspect at about 1 MP. 30 Euler steps on the shift-5 schedule, CFG 4 against the empty prompt.
